latest.text: Enjoying using this app and the phone companion has been quite handy, I also like the new interface. Great work

latest.author: rasagiovanni54-byte
latest.text: "I tried the app and I must say I am amazed by the stable streaming quality. However, I have a few suggestions: for example, not all channels load correctly, which might be due to something the app doesn't support. Also, the streaming quality leaves a bit to be desired; it is not broadcast with the desired quality. Even though the TV program is in Full HD, there is a lot of pixelation! I hope to see improvements in the app, which is still very good!! Keep it up 👍"
